title: German Carrot Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful German-inspired carrot stir fry made with fresh ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped parsley and stir for 1 minute.
Add the sliced carrots and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to tenderize.
Sprinkle the flaky sea salt and black pepper over the carrots and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Continue to stir-fry the carrots until they are tender and slightly caramelized.
Remove the skillet from the heat and serve the German carrot stir fry hot.
